working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Perineurial glial sheath' cluster(s) (Saavedra et al. 2023, Figure 3a), dissected adult male thoraces, control genotype.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any glial cell (FBbt:00005144) that is part of some adult nervous system (FBbt:00003559) and is part of some perineurial glial sheath (FBbt:00007089).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Perineurial glial sheath' (Fly Cell Atlas-based). Perineurial glia; not narrowed to the VNC, since the thorax's peripheral nerves also have a perineurial sheath (FCA rule).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058251 adult perineurial glial cell (exact match).
